title: Freestanding Makeup Mirror 8-Inch Double Faced 2X Solid Brass For Bathroom | Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade daily grooming with a freestanding make-up mirror featuring an 8-Inch double faced mirror and 2X magnification for detailed viewing. This traditional style vanity mirror is crafted from solid brass and is designed for bathroom placement without wall mounting.

Highlights:
- Double-sided mirror glass: 2X magnifying mirror on one side for close-up makeup/shaving, 1X on the other for a full view
- Freestanding design: place on the floor or move as needed; no wall mount required
- Heavy solid brass base helps prevent tipping
- Felt pad helps prevent scratching on surfaces
- Coordinates with traditional bathroom hardware and classic bath accessories

Specs:
- Category: Make-Up Mirrors
- Mirror diameter: 8-Inch
- Material: Brass
- Mounting type: Freestanding
- Dimensions: 10.5-Inch L x 10.5-Inch W
- Weight: 13.6 lb
- Included item(s): Make-up mirror
- Assembly required: Yes
- Finish selection: 25 designer finish options including statement colors

_previous.title: Adjustable Height Floor Standing Make-Up Mirror 8 Inch Diameter with 2X Magnification
_previous.description: Elegantly and efficiently designed, this floor standing 2 sided magnification mirror is an easy solution for your daily make-up or shaving routine.  The dual-sided mirror features a clear magnification for those close-up applications on one side and a 1x magnification on the opposite side for a quick all around check at any angle.  With classic accents, this free-standing vanity mirror is the crowning touch to your bathroom accessories.
